question: Why can two different equipotential surfaces never intersect each other?

options.A: Because the potential at the point of intersection would be zero.
options.B: Because it would imply two different values of potential at the same point, which is impossible.
options.C: Because the electric field would be zero at the intersection.
options.D: Because charges would accumulate at the intersection.
